sources.snippet: Overview ELECTRA (Efficiently Learning an Encoder that Classifies Token Replacements Accurately) is a pretraining method introduced by Clark et al. in 2020. The google/electra-base-discriminator is the discriminator component of the ELECTRA-base model. sources.snippet: Model Architecture Relevant source files This page documents the model architecture of ELECTRA (Efficiently Learning an Encoder that Classifies Token Replacements Accurately). ELECTRA is a transformer-based language model that uses a novel pre-training approach with a generator-discriminator framework for more efficient learning.
